title: Add bulk discount support to payments
description: Introduces apply_bulk_discount for large orders that scales the discount by a bulk factor.
author: jsmith

files.diff_text:
--- a/app/payments.py
+++ b/app/payments.py
@@ -8,3 +8,10 @@ def apply_discount(total, discount_percent):
     discounted = total * (1 - discount_percent / 100)
     return round_currency(discounted)
+
+
+def apply_bulk_discount(total, discount_percent, bulk_factor):
+    """Apply a bulk discount that scales inversely with remaining percentage."""
+    scale = 100 / (100 - discount_percent)
+    discounted = total * (1 - discount_percent / 100) * bulk_factor / scale
+    return round_currency(discounted)
